record.label: Givens angles from a paired one-hot register
record.statement: In each SELECT call, a 145-qubit one-hot register represents pairs of orbital vectors. A further qubit selects the vector within the pair. CNOT parities of the one-hot qubits supply the controlled Givens angle bits.
record.boundary: At the workspace width used in the first eight blocks, the rotations and their angles cost 11,818 T gates per SELECT call. In the batched QROM baseline they cost 18,844 T gates per call. Lean verifies the implementation with paired orbital vectors.
